message:
POSC 320: add doc title and citation requirements to Stage 5

The Stage 5 Google Doc criterion now states requirements that have been
flagged in student feedback for several weeks but never actually enforced:
the document must be titled "Management Brief - [Last Name] - [Topic
Choice]", carry the student's name, and end with a complete APA reference
list. Also spells out page numbers on every Kettl citation and labeling
every stage.

Mirrors the same change made to the Canvas rubric and assignment
description for Stage 5 (assignment 39803685, rubric 3687905).
